تنتهبين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِبِينَ (tantahibīna) /tan.ta.hi.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# تُنْتَهَبِينَ (tuntahabīna) /tun.ta.ha.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
